01 / ABOUT ME

You don't need
all the answers.
Just a place to start.

When I discovered Microsoft Learn, I realized learning doesn't have to be complicated. Often all it takes is a useful starting point and a little encouragement.

That's why I share carefully selected resources, practical ideas, and opportunities that can help turn something you've learned into something you can actually use.

04 / FREQUENTLY ASKED

Questions?

A few answers before you begin.

01What does a Microsoft Student Ambassador do?

Members of the Microsoft Student Ambassadors program help others explore technology, share knowledge, and build learning communities.

02Who is the recommended learning path for?

Both beginners and learners with some experience who want to develop their skills with more direction. Microsoft Learn lets you study at your own pace.

03Can I learn on Microsoft Learn for free?

Yes, Microsoft Learn learning content is freely available. Some certification exams may have a separate fee.

04How can I contact you?

Email me directly at belazoltan.kovacs@studentambassadors.com or connect on LinkedIn.
